message.content:
This document describes **Project Maya**, a local LLM inference stack for running large MoE models on consumer/prosumer hardware. Key technical points:

**Quantization tiers (Maya XS/S/M/L)**
- Named by model + tier, where tier reflects expert bit-width. Each quant preserves the model's MTP (multi-token prediction) drafting block.
- GLM-5.3-Flash quants: Maya-S (96.5 GB, 97.9% zero-shot accuracy vs FP8, 83% same-next-token), Maya-S24 (94.7 GB, 4-bit attention
